# PIPELINE: approved HTML -> JSON -> Roblox ScreenGui

`SK=<this skill's folder>`. All commands run from the project's `ui/` folder unless noted.

## 0. Project layout (created in SKILL.md step 4)
```
<game repo>/
  ui/                      HTML source of truth (served by a preview server)
    build.py  kit.css  styles/  style.css  ref.png  stud.png  tex/  icons/  icons.json  rbx.json
                           (stud.png + tex/ = your ui-resources downloads; icons/ = copied from your pack)
    *.html                 generated by build.py (never hand-edit)
    rbx/out/               export output: <page>.json, raw/, upload/, upload_list.json, uploaded.json (LEDGER), mock/
  roblox/ui/               "luau_out": Builder.luau, AssetIds.luau, Data_*.luau, UIKit.luau, NumberFormat.luau, Theme.luau
    client/                UI.luau (runtime module), Controller.client.luau (+ other client modules)
```
Copy the Luau templates once (SKILL.md step 6 has the exact commands): every `templates/luau/*.luau` into
`roblox/ui/` and `templates/luau/client/*` into `roblox/ui/client/`, except `LoadingScreen.client.luau`
(ReplicatedFirst) and `CrateRoll.luau` (ReplicatedStorage, shared with the server). Builder ships every other
root module into the ScreenGui so LocalScripts can require them (`gui.UIKit`, `gui.UpdateInPlace`, ...).
Replace `"<Gui>"` in UI.luau with the gui name.

## 1. `rbx.json` (export config)
```json
{
  "gui": "GameUI",                    // ScreenGui name in StarterGui
  "templates_folder": "GameUITemplates", // ReplicatedStorage folder for runtime templates
  "port": 8870,                       // preview server port (pages + upload URLs)
  "design": [1920, 1080],             // stage size = Roblox design size
  "luau_out": "../roblox/ui",         // where Data_*.luau / AssetIds.luau are written
  "stud_asset": "",                   // optional uploaded stud texture id for runtime/world use
  "font_map": {"Montserrat": "GothamSSm"},  // optional: CSS family -> Roblox family file (glass preset)
  "screens": [
    {"name": "HUD", "page": "hud", "groups": ["Currencies", "LeftButtons", "Goal"], "visible": true, "hud": true},
    {"name": "Shop", "page": "shop", "groups": ["Shop"]},
    {"name": "X", "page": "x", "groups": ["A", {"page": "other", "group": "B", "visible": false}]}
  ],
  "templates": ["templates"]          // pages whose every top-level group becomes a template
}
```
(JSON has no comments; the example `templates/examples/rbx.json` is clean.) Screen order = z order: later
screens draw above earlier ones; `hud: true` screens sit under every panel and hide while one is open (except
groups in `UI.keepWithPanel`). `dim` (0-1) overrides the scrim; otherwise a `Dim` FILL group on the page sets it.

## 2. Export markers (what dump.js understands)
| HTML | Roblox |
|---|---|
| `grp(name, html, anchor)` = `<div class='abs fill grp' data-g data-a>` | top-level Frame `name` in the screen, anchored TL/T/TR/L/C/R/BL/B/BR to that screen edge (keeps its design distance from the edge on any aspect ratio); `FILL` = full screen |
| `sub(name, html, btn, opens)` | invisible Frame (box = union of children); `btn` -> TextButton + attribute `Button=true` |
| `data-n='Name'` (`name=` in build.py helpers) | instance name; runtime looks it up. Unnamed text -> `T_<Text>`, icons -> `I_<slug>` |
| `data-btn=1` | TextButton + `Button` attribute (UI.juicy wires hover/press/click) |
| `data-opens='Shop'` | attribute `Opens` -> the button toggles that screen |
| class `hid` / `opacity:0` | exported, `Visible=false` (states the runtime toggles). `display:none` = not exported |
| `.ot` outlined text | TextLabel + UIStroke (+ `<Name>Shadow` twin for the drop, + UIGradient for fills) |
| plain text node | TextLabel, no stroke |
| `<img src='icons/<slug>.png'>` | ImageLabel `icon:<slug>`, ScaleType Fit; drop-shadow filter -> shadow twin; brightness-only filter -> ImageColor3 |
| `.plate`, a child with `url()` + `mix-blend-mode:overlay`, `clip-path`, `url()` / layered backgrounds, filters on boxes, other `<img>`, SVG shapes | **raster**: screenshotted alone at 2x on transparent, becomes ImageLabel art; its text/icon children stay live |
| div with bg colour / single linear-gradient / border / radius / box-shadow / outline / overflow hidden | native Frame + UICorner + UIStroke + UIGradient (+ ShadowRing / DropShadow / InnerRing / InnerShade frames) |
| radial-gradient | `glow` image tinted with the first stop |
| conic-gradient | `Cooldown` frame (two clipped rotating halves, attribute `Frac`) |
| SVG `<line>` | rotated Frame |
| `.world`, `.rbx`, `.cap` | never exported (stand-in world, Roblox control placeholders, captions) |
| `data-col='#hex'` on SVG shapes | art exported white-tinted, `ImageColor3` = that colour (recolour at runtime) |

## 3. Commands
```bash
python3 build.py                                  # HTML
node $SK/scripts/export.mjs [page ...]            # 1. layout JSON + raster PNGs  (needs the preview server)
python3 $SK/scripts/gen.py                        # 2. dedupe art, Data_*.luau, upload_list.json
python3 $SK/scripts/mock.py && node $SK/scripts/mockshot.mjs   # offline check: mean diff 1-3 per screen
python3 $SK/scripts/ledger.py 20                  # 3. next 20 URLs to upload (repeat with the upload result piped in)
python3 $SK/scripts/assets.py                     #    AssetIds.luau
python3 $SK/scripts/bundle.py                     # 4. rbx/out/<Gui>Build.rbxmx
```
Then in Studio (robloxstudio MCP, edit mode):
```lua
-- a) remove the previous bundle (execute_luau)
local old = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("GameUIBuild") if old then old:Destroy() end
```
b) `import_rbxm {source:{path:"<abs path>/rbx/out/GameUIBuild.rbxmx"}, parent_path:"game.ServerStorage"}`
```lua
-- c) build (execute_luau)
return require(game.ServerStorage.GameUIBuild.Builder).build()
-- d) fit pass: text must render to measure
local B = require(game.ServerStorage.GameUIBuild.Builder)
local g = game.StarterGui.GameUI; g.Enabled = true
task.wait(1); local a = B.fit(); task.wait(0.5); local b = B.fit(); g.Enabled = false
return a .. " | " .. b
```
Expect "fit: n/m labels resized (worst ...)" twice with the second worst near 1-2%.

## 4. CSS -> Roblox mapping (what gen.py + Builder do)
| CSS | Roblox |
|---|---|
| absolute px in a 1920x1080 stage | Offset px under `Root` (design size) with UIScale `FitScale = min(vw/1920, vh/1080)`; Root resized to viewport/scale at runtime |
| font-size N | TextSize N x 1.215 (cap 100 -> `<Name>Big` frame with UIScale) |
| `-webkit-text-stroke` W | UIStroke Contextual, Thickness W/2, LineJoin Round |
| text-shadow 0 dy 0 | `<Name>Shadow` TextLabel in outline colour, +dy |
| `::after` gradient fill | TextColor3 white + UIGradient Rotation 90 |
| color | TextColor3 |
| text-align / flex justify | TextXAlignment |
| background-color rgba | BackgroundColor3 + BackgroundTransparency (1 - a) |
| linear-gradient(A deg) | white background + UIGradient Rotation A - 90 (+ Transparency sequence), max 20 keypoints |
| border W solid | UIStroke ApplyStrokeMode Border, Inner, Thickness W |
| border-radius R / 50% | UICorner Offset R / Scale 0.5 |
| box-shadow 0 0 0 S (outer, on glass) | `ShadowRing` frame with an Outer UIStroke S |
| box-shadow 0 Y 0 (outer, on glass) | `DropShadow` crescent clipped below the box |
| box-shadow (outer, opaque box) | `DropShadow` frame behind |
| inset 0 0 0 S | `InnerRing` (Inner UIStroke) |
| inset 0 Y 0 | `InnerShade` band |
| outline W offset O | `Outline` frame, Outer UIStroke |
| overflow hidden | ClipsDescendants |
| transform rotate | Rotation |
| opacity 0 / .hid | Visible false |
| img (pack icon) | ImageLabel Fit |
| anything rasterised | ImageLabel Stretch (art key), wide stud plates 3-sliced: `ArtL` + `ArtT` (ScaleType Tile, TileSize = one stud period) + `ArtR` |
| blurred box-shadow | dropped (bake it into art if it matters) |
| dashed border | dropped (draw dashes as art) |

## 5. Data node format (`Data_<Screen>.luau` = `return [==[ json ]==]`)
`{c: class, n: name, x, y, w, h (offset px), sx, sy, sw, sh (scale), ax, ay (anchor), fill, visible, rot,
bg, bt, clip, corner {s|o}, stroke {t,c,tr,pos,mode}, grad {rot,c:[[p,r,g,b]],tr}, img ("art:<key>"|"icon:<slug>"),
st (Fit|Stretch|Tile), tile [w,h], ic (ImageColor3), it, txt, font (family file name), wt, ts, tc, xa (L|C|R),
scale (UIScale), cool, attrs {Button, Opens, Anchor, FitW, Dim, Frac}, k: [children]}`.
Never edit Data files by hand; fix the HTML and regenerate. If a hand fix in Studio is unavoidable, make the
same fix in the HTML in the same turn, or the next rebuild reverts it.

## 6. The upload ledger
`rbx/out/uploaded.json` maps `art:<key>` / `icon:<slug>` -> `rbxassetid://...`. Art keys are content hashes
(`a` + md5 prefix, fuzzy-deduped), so re-exporting unchanged art reuses ids and only changed pieces upload.
Never delete the ledger; copy it to a new game only if the same owner uploads for both. Icon slugs are permanent
once uploaded (rename = re-upload).

## 7. Template contract (runtime UI)
- Every runtime element (toast, confirm, reward popup, tutorial card, building bubble, billboard, list row) is
  designed on `templates.html` as its own `grp(Name, ..., 'TL')` and built into
  `ReplicatedStorage.<templates_folder>.<Name>` (a Frame at 0,0 sized in design px). AssetIds is copied there too.
- Game code: `local t = UIKit.template("Toast_info")` (nil + warning if missing: check before blocking input),
  fill with `UIKit.set(UIKit.find(t, "Msg1"), text)` (syncs `Msg1Shadow`), `UIKit.icon(...)`, `UIKit.bar(bar, f)`
  (fill child `F`), `UIKit.scaled(t)` (UIScale for the screen), parent into the ONE overlay ScreenGui (or a
  BillboardGui sized from `t.Size`). Pressable parts are TextButtons with `Button`; wire them with `UI.juicy`.
- Never `Instance.new` a look in game code. A missing piece = design it on templates.html, approve, rebuild.

## 8. Changes made to imported screens at runtime
Keep a section in the game's UI notes (e.g. `ui/RUNTIME_UI.md`) listing every runtime edit to imported
screens, e.g. "Shop cards: cloned from Card_open / Card_locked at the mock's slot positions"; "labels written at
runtime get TextScaled + UITextSizeConstraint(max = design size)"; "Map screen hides its painted background so
the live 3D map shows".
Also list every runtime element with: source function, purpose, contents, states, position. Append only.

## 9. Keeping runtime copies in sync
The UI module exists on disk (`roblox/ui/client/UI.luau`), in `ServerStorage.<Gui>Build.Client.UI`, and in
`StarterGui.<Gui>.UI` (Builder copies it). Fixes made in only one copy drift (a builder copy fell 430 lines behind;
a rebuild would have installed it and crashed the HUD). Rules:
- Disk is the source of truth. Edit there, re-bundle, rebuild (or `bundle.py --client` + replace the scripts).
- Before and after pushing, snapshot the Studio copies (`mcp__robloxstudio__get_script_source` into
  `snapshot/<path>.luau`) and run `python3 $SK/scripts/check_copies.py copies.json` (groups of files that must be
  identical; exit 1 on drift).
- Guard optional APIs (`if UI.PageChanged then ... end`) so an older copy can't kill a bridge.
- Run `luau-analyze --mode=nonstrict <file>` on every client file before importing. Files marked `--!strict`
  stay strict and, without Roblox type definitions, print type errors on Roblox classes: what matters are
  SyntaxError lines (ambiguous-syntax casts) and "Unknown global" for YOUR OWN function names (a local used
  before its declaration). Ignore "Unknown global 'game'/'Instance'..." and "Unknown type" noise.

## 10. Updating a screen later
Edit build.py -> `python3 build.py` -> show the developer -> on approval: `export.mjs <page>` -> `gen.py` ->
mock check -> `ledger.py` (only changed art uploads) -> `assets.py` -> `bundle.py` -> import -> `build()` ->
`fit()` x2 -> verify. Builder replaces the whole ScreenGui; runtime state lives in game code, so a rebuild is safe.
To update ONE panel without a full rebuild (keeps other screens untouched):
`require(game.ServerStorage.<Gui>Build.Builder).buildScreen("Shop")`, then `fit(StarterGui.<Gui>.Root.Shop)`
with the gui Enabled. Runtime code that cached references to the old frame must re-find it (or re-init in a
playtest).
